author: SickProdigy
description: Protected fixed-supply ERC-20 deployments on Base, with Sepolia enabled and a default-off mainnet release candidate.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores public token deployment drafts, public deployment records, and product-specific mainnet terms acceptance records linked to Discord user IDs and public wallet addresses. It never stores wallet keys, recovery material, or credentials.
install_msg: TokenFactory enables reviewed Base Sepolia deployments. Its Base mainnet release candidate remains default-off until the pinned factory and ordinary-member path pass acceptance. Load CryptoWallet for the optional Discord Wallet route; external-wallet deployment remains product-specific.
